title: TI ADS1298 datasheet SBAS459K: VCAP1 reference output, 22 uF bypass, 2.4 V/4 V
what_they_did: The SBAS459K datasheet gives the ADS1298 VCAP1 pin as the internal reference amplifier output (2.4 V for a 3-V analog supply or 4 V for a 5-V supply), requires a 22-uF capacitor from VCAP1 to AVSS, and warns that noise on the VCAP1 node degrades performance; it states no ESR or leakage limit for that capacitor.
useful_for_us: Supplies the exact VCAP1 DC voltage (2.4 V/4 V, page 33) and the 22-uF requirement (page 10), so the capacitor can be rated against the real 4 V maximum instead of a guessed rail voltage.

title: LCSC C215879: Vishay T58MM226M6R3C0300 22 uF 6.3 V polymer tantalum
what_they_did: The LCSC product page lists the Vishay T58MM226M6R3C0300 as a 22-uF, +/-20 %, 6.3-V tantalum-polymer capacitor in case 1608-10 (MM) with 300-mOhm ESR, 15,706 pieces in stock and a 1-off price of $0.5663.
useful_for_us: Confirms the LCSC stock and 1-off price for the best low-profile candidate and shows that LCSC itself classifies it as a tantalum-polymer part.

title: LCSC C19941081: KEMET T597S226M010APE100 22 uF 10 V polymer tantalum
what_they_did: The LCSC product page lists the KEMET T597S226M010APE100 as a 22-uF, +/-20 %, 10-V tantalum-polymer capacitor in case 3216-11 with 100-mOhm ESR, 40 pieces in stock and a 1-off price of $0.8413.
useful_for_us: Gives the 10-V alternative with a 1.2-mm maximum height and its exact stock and price, so the report can compare it with the 6.3-V Vishay part.

title: LCSC C3202863: Zhenhua XinYun CA45A-P-6.3V-22UF-K 22 uF 6.3 V tantalum
what_they_did: The LCSC product page lists the CA45A-P-6.3V-22UF-K as a 22-uF, +/-10 %, 6.3-V manganese-dioxide tantalum capacitor in case 2012-12 with 1.4-uA leakage, 240 pieces in stock and a 1-off price of $0.0747.
useful_for_us: Documents the cheapest 2012-12 candidate and its 1.2-mm nominal height, which the datasheet tolerance turns into a 1.4-mm maximum and therefore a rejection by the 1.25-mm rule.

title: Vishay T58 vPolyTan polymer tantalum datasheet (Doc. 40189)
what_they_did: The Vishay T58 datasheet gives the MM/1608-09 case as 1.6 x 0.85 mm with a 0.90-mm maximum height, lists the 22-uF 6.3-V part with 300-mOhm maximum ESR and 14-uA maximum DCL at 25 C, prints the anode polarity bar marking, and derates a 6.3-V part to 5.0 V continuous.
useful_for_us: Supplies the mechanical, leakage, ESR and polarity figures for the best pick, and its derating table proves that the 6.3-V part still has 1 V of margin over the 4-V maximum VCAP1 voltage.

title: KEMET T597 polymer tantalum datasheet (T2073_T59X)
what_they_did: The KEMET T59X datasheet gives case S/3216-12 as 3.2 x 1.6 x 1.1 mm (+/-0.1 mm), lists T597S226M010APE100 at 22 uF and 10 V with 100-mOhm ESR and 66-uA maximum leakage (0.3 CV), and shows the anode (+) and cathode (-) end marking with a polarity bar.
useful_for_us: Supplies the 1.2-mm maximum height, leakage and ESR figures for the second qualifying part and shows that it is the higher-voltage, higher-temperature option.

title: Zhenhua XinYun CA45A tantalum capacitor datasheet
what_they_did: The Chinese-language CA45A datasheet gives case P/2012-12 as 2.0 x 1.25 x 1.2 mm with +/-0.2-mm tolerances, so the maximum height is 1.4 mm, and states that leakage is measured at rated voltage after 5 minutes.
useful_for_us: Proves that the cheap 2012-12 part cannot be used under a hard 1.25-mm maximum-height rule even though its nominal height is 1.2 mm.

title: KiCad footprint CP_EIA-1608-10_AVX-L (Capacitor_Tantalum_SMD)
what_they_did: The KiCad library file defines CP_EIA-1608-10_AVX-L with the description 'Tantalum Capacitor SMD AVX-L (1608-10 Metric), IPC-7352 nominal, (Body size from: https://www.vishay.com/docs/48064/_t58_vmn_pt0471_1601.pdf)'.
useful_for_us: Gives the exact standard KiCad footprint name for the 1608-10 case and explicitly ties it to the Vishay T58 body drawing used by the best pick.

title: KiCad Capacitor_Tantalum_SMD.pretty footprint listing
what_they_did: The GitLab tree lists the Capacitor_Tantalum_SMD footprints, including CP_EIA-1608-10_AVX-L, CP_EIA-2012-12_Kemet-R, CP_EIA-3216-12_Kemet-S and CP_EIA-3216-18_Kemet-A, each with a normal and a HandSolder variant.
useful_for_us: Confirms which standard KiCad tantalum footprints exist and that the 1608-10, 2012-12 and 3216-12 names used in the report are the official library names.

title: JLCPCB parts library search
what_they_did: The JLCPCB parts library search is the public entry point to the assembly library and returns the library class (Basic or Extended), JLCPCB stock and quantity-1 price for each part; the two picks come back as Extended with 15,708 and 40 pieces respectively.
useful_for_us: It is the source for the JLCPCB class, JLCPCB stock and JLCPCB 1-off price columns, and it shows that both picks are Extended rather than Basic parts.
